title: Cosmic Crown Nebula
description: A surreal cosmic scene featuring an ornate golden crown floating in the center of a swirling purple and blue vortex resembling a galaxy or black hole. The crown is adorned with intricate filigree, spikes, and glowing purple and yellow gemstones, set against a starry space background with a luminous horizon above.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal cosmic artwork of an ornate golden crown floating above a swirling purple and blue galactic vortex that resembles a black hole or nebula. The crown is decorated with intricate filigree, sharp spikes, and glowing purple and golden gemstones. Stars and cosmic dust swirl around the crown against a deep space background with a soft luminous atmospheric horizon in the distance, mystical and ethereal atmosphere.
